name: Bard Beguiling Performer
body:
All bards are beguiling to some extent but the beguiling performer learns methods to hide their spellcasting in their performances to catch their targets unawares.

Performative Magic (Ex)

While the beguiling performer has their bardic performance active, they may disguise their spellcasting by making a Perform check, using the perform type that matches their bardic performance method, opposed by an observer’s Sense Motive. On a failure, the observer is considered flat-footed to any spell attack roll and they do not know you are casting a spell until they suffer its effects.

This ability replaces countersong.

Surprise Spell (Su)

Beginning at 5th level, If a target is unaware of the beguiling performer’s spellcasting, either because they are flat-footed or because the beguiling performer succeeded in using the performative magic ability, the DCs of the spell cast is increased by 1. This bonus increases by 1 every 5 levels thereafter. This ability uses 3 rounds of bardic music to activate and is a free action.

This ability replaces lore master.
